[[File:Staff of fire detail.png|left|110px]]A '''staff of fire''' is the basic fire [[elemental staff]]. It provides unlimited amounts of [[Fire rune|fire runes]] as well as the [[autocast]] option when equipped. All elemental staves offer the same [[Magic]] bonuses and only differ by the type of [[Runes|rune]] they supply and their [[Melee]] stats.

The staff can be purchased from various shops across [[Gielinor]], including [[Zaff's Superior Staffs!]] in [[Varrock]]. It can also be bought on the [[Grand Exchange]], obtained through other players, or dropped by various enemies.

Players with access to a [[crystal ball]] within a [[player-owned house]] may change the element of this staff.

When equipped, players are granted the [[fiery (attribute)|fiery attribute]] and will therefore receive additional damage in [[PvP]] from the special effects of [[Pearl bolts (e)]] and [[Pearl dragon bolts (e)]].
